People picker

Choose who belongs to something. Group toggles represent whole circles, each row has its own checkbox, and an optional trailing column holds one control per person.

Try the circle toggles, individual selections, organizer switches and Clear selection. These examples keep changes in this page only; reloading resets them. Saving and access rules belong to your application. See the people picker manual for the submission contract.

Space members with circles and organizers

One circle is selected. Each detail line says why the person is included. Removing someone excludes them from the selected circles. Di Ng is required and stays selected when you clear the others.
